title: Qcqs higher direct images preserve a fixed set of torsion primes
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\mathcal P$ be any set of primes and let $F\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$ be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Assume that for every geometric point $\bar u$ of $U$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] and every $x\in F_{\bar u}$ there is a positive integer $n$ with $nx=0$ and with every prime divisor of $n$ in $\mathcal P$. Then for every integer $q\geq0$, every geometric point $\bar v$ of $V$, and every $y\in(R^qu_*F)_{\bar v}$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], there is a positive integer $m$ with $my=0$ and with every prime divisor of $m$ in $\mathcal P$.
